rules.pass: No version floor refuses the running version at the relay's height or later.
rules.warn: A later milestone will refuse the running version.
rules.fail: The version floor refuses the running version now.
rules.unknown: The floor or the relay's height could not be read. The height comes from the relay's API, else from its store, so the API may be off.
rules.skipped: This host does not run a relay.

advice.ok: The version {version} is accepted at height {height}.
advice.refused: At height {height} the version floor in force refuses the version {version}, so peers refuse this node. Install the release named in the announcement. See https://docs.iceroot.com/validators/doctor/#version-floor.
advice.later: From height {from} (in about {days} days {hours} hours) peers refuse the version {version}. Install the release named in the announcement before then. See https://docs.iceroot.com/validators/doctor/#version-floor.
advice.later-height: From height {from} peers refuse the version {version}; the relay is at height {height}. Install the release named in the announcement before then. See https://docs.iceroot.com/validators/doctor/#version-floor.

rules.pass: The role runs the version that is installed.
rules.warn: The role runs a version other than the installed one.
rules.unknown: The role's version could not be read.
rules.skipped: The role is not running here.

advice.restart-pending: The {role} still runs {running} while {installed} is installed. Restart it with `heartwood {role} restart`. See https://docs.iceroot.com/validators/doctor/#version-installed.

rules.pass: This build has no test-only code. A devnet build passes.

advice.release-build: This build has no test-only code.
advice.test-build: This build has test-only code. Install a release build. See https://docs.iceroot.com/validators/doctor/#version-build.

rules.pass: At most half of the peers run a newer release than this build.
rules.warn: More than half of the peers run a newer release.
rules.unknown: The peer list is empty or could not be read.
rules.skipped: This host does not run a relay.

advice.current: {newer} of {total} peers run a newer release.
advice.mostly-newer: {newer} of {total} peers run a newer release. Check the announcements. See https://docs.iceroot.com/validators/doctor/#version-peers.
